matching_2GeV.note: author code (CPevenDecay.cpp): pi pi / K K / 4pi are set to the 1e-40 floor for mH>2; s sbar and g g are 0 for mH<2; at exactly mH=2.0 both sets are computed because the cuts are strict inequalities. The hadronic (dispersion-relation) and partonic (spectator) descriptions are therefore joined by a genuine discontinuity: above 2 GeV the hadronic channels are switched off abruptly and the partonic s sbar / g g turn on. The jump factor above/below depends on how much of the width is hadronic vs diphoton at that tanb; numerically the total width is continuous across 2 GeV to 0.05-0.5% because the 4pi coefficient C=5.1e-9 was tuned by the authors to make the hadronic and partonic descriptions meet there, while the individual channel widths jump. This is the intended matching of the program (paper: 'Decays to hadrons and quarks/gluons are connected at m_H=2 GeV'), not a bug, but it must be kept in mind when interpolating across 2 GeV.

no_bbbar.comment: the author CP-even-H module has no H->b bbar partial width at all (partonic channels are c cbar, s sbar, g g only); this is why the physics scan is restricted to mH <= 10 GeV.

ctau.note: the foreseen tables were built with the rounded hbar*c = 2.0e-16 GeV m; the ratio with our canonical hbar*c = 1.973269804e-16 is then 1.973269804/2.0 = 0.98663490 by construction
